component.name: Wisp
component.summary: A small, fast, quiet web browser

description.p: Wisp is a browser with nothing in the way: a row of tabs, one field, and the page. It uses WebKitGTK, the WebKit already on your system, so it is small and starts instantly.

ul.li: An ad and tracker blocker that runs inside WebKit, before the page loads
Hide any element on a site, for good
Reading mode, private tabs, pinned tabs, tabs that sleep when idle
No account, no sync, no telemetry
